Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Kavita - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Anil - 45 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Vimla - 75 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Isha - 11 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay hides behind the tree.]

Tanay: "That's great!"

[Tanay whispers something to Mother.]

Kavita: "Tanay, look at this."

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Tanay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
